# Synthetic scene-boundary replay, not a retail capture. Pixels are RGBA8.
# Unit mesh spans x=[-.5,.5], y=[-.5,.5]. 64x32 target, identity camera.
version 1
# observe owner generation translation-x R G B (byte colors)
observe 100 1 -0.25 255 0 0
observe 200 1 0.25 0 0 255
# publish label tick expected-instance-count
publish initial 1 2
# Independent oracle: integer rectangles, end coordinates exclusive; later wins.
rect initial 8 8 40 24 255 0 0
rect initial 24 8 56 24 0 0 255
# Update one existing lifetime: retained initial image must not change.
observe 100 1 0.5 0 255 0
publish updated 2 2
rect updated 32 8 64 24 0 255 0
rect updated 24 8 56 24 0 0 255
# Retire and reuse the same owner address with a fresh generation/native id.
retire 100
observe 100 2 -0.5 255 255 0
publish reused 3 2
rect reused 24 8 56 24 0 0 255
rect reused 0 8 32 24 255 255 0
retire 100
retire 200
publish empty 4 0
# Destroy producer/mesh references before consuming any retained publication.
release_producer
render reused
render initial
render empty
render updated
render initial
